In the second example, they had "受贿;滥用职权" for a government official. Here, the defendant is a manager of a private company (original fuel division). So it's a non-state employee. The appropriate label is "非国家工作人员受贿". The list includes that label. So answer: [罪名]非国家工作人员受贿<eoa>.

Check if any other crimes? Only bribery. No other wrongdoing. So single charge.
